direct_collapse.verdict: Rejected: needle-edge fragments, faceted snow and failure to reach middle budget.

rendered_review.verdict: Promising rounded snow and denser layered crown in game. Continue this isolated direction; not production acceptance.
rendered_review.limits: Static spruce near/middle only; original other families, far cards, shadows, placement and physics. Flat trunk texture and species/snow-load variation need work; far LOD, moving transitions, wind/contact and FPS not accepted.
